content: Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same therapeutic class. To view formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly.
